name: Shroomveil
storyline:
The peaceful, small-statured Emberlings once lived in the bustling industrial cities of the North. Their size made them easy targets for exploitation and abuse, forced into labor by those who saw them as weak and insignificant.

One day, a curious young Emberling named Draxen ventured farther than ever before, deep into the wild forests beyond the city’s edge. After days of wandering through swamps, climbing icy mountains, and crossing frozen glaciers, Draxen stumbled upon a breathtaking meadow unlike anything he had ever seen — a land of towering mushrooms, shimmering magic, and endless wonder.

The air was calm, the soil rich, and the land teemed with life. It was a place where crops could flourish, goats could roam, and the Emberlings could finally be free. Among the many strange mushrooms growing there, one stood out — a magical shroom with the power to teleport anyone who touched it back home.

When Draxen returned, he shared his discovery with the others. Soon, a great gathering was held, and it was decided that the Emberlings would leave the cruel cities behind to build a new home in this magical land — a place they would name Emberveil.

For centuries, the Emberlings lived in peace, hidden away from the outside world. But peace cannot last forever. In time, the same dark forces that once oppressed them rediscovered their thriving villages — now more twisted and cruel than ever, enslaving creatures and spreading corruption.

Now, the Emberlings need your help to defend Emberveil, restore balance, and protect their enchanted homeland from those who would destroy it.
summary: Shroomveil is a real-time combat, Action RPG, with character progression, skills, and gear upgrades. Set in a magical, mushroom-filled world full of danger and discovery, you'll explore a beautiful fantasy land, find and defend villages, equip warriors, clear dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring peace to the land.
